ios.desc:
The only iOS screen recorder with a truly live face cam overlay. Record your screen and camera at the same time, with your face shown in real-time, not edited in after like other apps. Perfect for reaction videos, gameplay with face cam, tutorials, product demos, and live streaming.

Show every tap with customizable touch indicators. Draw on screen. Read from the built-in teleprompter. Stream directly to Twitch, YouTube, or any RTMP server.

Built especially for demoing websites, reacting to videos, and presenting photos.

Perfect for showcasing web-based products to investors, recording tutorials, or streaming to Twitch and YouTube.

Record tutorials that show exactly where to tap. Stream web-based games directly to Twitch. All in the popular face cam format, with touch indicators showing every gesture. There's nothing else like it.

Five recording modes: websites in the built-in browser, videos from your camera roll, photos as a slideshow, any app on your phone (Pro), or Clip Mode for gaming highlights (Pro). The any-app mode lets you take your live face cam anywhere on iOS 18 and later, recording over games, social apps, or anything else on your device.

Clip Mode (Pro) is built for gamers and reaction creators. Start a session and play normally. When something amazing happens, tap your Action Button or Control Center button to instantly save the last 30 seconds to your camera roll. Build your highlight reel without ever stopping the action.

Draw directly on the screen during recordings to circle buttons, underline text, or guide viewers through complex interfaces.

Add as many text overlays as you like, then drag, resize, and edit them anywhere on screen to label what you're showing or add context.

The face cam is draggable and resizable. Tap to reposition, pinch to resize. Choose between circle, square, or rectangle shapes, or switch to a full-screen face cam with one tap. Touch indicators display every tap, swipe, and gesture. Customize the color, size, and opacity to match your style so viewers always know exactly what you're doing.

Need to stay on script? The built-in teleprompter lets you read prepared notes while recording. Detach it, resize it, and move it anywhere on screen. Your script stays visible to you but invisible in the final video.

All of these tools live in a control panel that's available throughout your recording but never appears in the final video, so you get full creative control without any visual clutter. Pause a recording

quotes.text:
I built this because I couldn’t find it.

Wanted to record demos of my web game with my face on screen. iOS screen recording doesn’t do face cam. Loom is desktop only. OBS is a whole thing.

So I made Demo Scope.

Load any mobile site in the built-in browser, hit record. Face cam is draggable and resizable. Touch indicators show every tap. Also does streaming, annotations, and narration over videos/photos from camera roll.

Free to try. $9.99 one-time. No subscription.

Marketing site: https://demoscope.app

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/demo-scope/id6755395174

Would love feedback.

Hi everyone,

I made this app

Demo Scope lets you record or stream any mobile website with your face on screen and touch indicators showing every tap.

I built it because I needed to demo my own side projects and hated the OBS/desktop setup.

Load your site in the app, hit record, done. Or stream straight to Twitch/YouTube.

Free to try: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/demo-scope/id6755395174

Would love feedback if anyone tries it.

I made a landing site centered around mobile demos for professional projects, but my main use case honestly has been Twitch streaming browser based games from my phone.
